content.title: Cyber Monday: Consumers search for value in K-shaped economy
content.description:
In spite of growing concerns of an affordability crisis in the US, consumers are spending big at the start of the holiday shopping season. Adobe Analytics expects consumers to spend a record $14.2 billion on Cyber Monday purchases.

Yahoo Finance senior reporter Brooke DiPalma, Winthrop Capital CIO Adam Coons, and HSBC Head of Equity Strategy for the Americas Nicole Inui comment on the state of the US consumer under the pressure of a K-shaped economy.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid.
